description: Voice DNA configuration: authentic human tone guidelines and banned AI vocabulary.
pacing_rules: Short paragraphs: 1-2 sentences default, 3 sentences max.
Get straight to the point: no warm-up laps or empty introductory filler.
Vary sentence length: short punchy lines mixed with concrete evidence.
Direct active voice: use 'I' and 'you', avoiding passive corporate constructions.
Concrete facts over buzzwords: specific tools, metrics, and outcomes instead of abstract claims.
Physical action verbs over corporate metaphors (built, designed, shipped, cut, fixed, deployed).
Never use em dashes (—). Use commas, periods, or parentheses instead.
